purpose: Deterministic source-and-field contract for monitoring decision-material pricing, billing, AI packaging, plan-generation and affiliate-term drift without provider calls or automatic publication.

global_rules.authoritative_sources: official vendor pricing/help/legal/affiliate surfaces only for normalized facts
global_rules.missing_source: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE -> HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED; never silently reuse stale value

clickup.decision_job: Determine whether public pricing is applicable to the exact Workspace generation before making an upgrade/AI-cost claim.

sources.current_anchor: Limited rollout; current plan/price stay the same; no automatic migration; only upgrade options change; new plans include AI; all Free Forever, new Workspaces, and a small number of paid Workspaces may see new plans.
Public Brain AI $9/user/month and Everything AI $28/user/month context exists; public price is not treated as proof of a specific Workspace invoice.

forced_review_conditions: classic add-on and new AI-included surfaces coexist in the same Workspace
public price conflicts with Workspace-specific billing/upgrade surface

make.decision_job: Normalize workload cost across credits, dynamic AI consumption, plan tiers and affiliate economics without assuming one operation always equals one credit.

sources.current_anchor: At 10k credits/month public surface shows Free 1,000 credits/month, Core $12/month, Pro $21/month, Teams $38/month; monthly/annual controls exist. Ordinary module action language is one credit but exceptions must be checked against Credits help.

Default fixed usage is 1 operation = 1 credit; some AI/advanced features use dynamic credits based on tokens/other usage; custom AI provider connections separate Make operation credits from provider token cost.

Headline/FAQ repeatedly state 35% for 12 months; payout requires $100 and 3 unique paying referrals via Wise. The same current page also contains a later affiliate-vs-partner FAQ sentence saying affiliate commission for 24 months, creating a material internal conflict.
35% on affiliate-link referrals for 12 months; $100 minimum and 3 unique paying users; subscription payments only; Wise payout.

claims: 24 months on one current affiliate-page FAQ sentence

n8n.decision_job: Keep workflow execution economics separate from AI-credit economics and affiliate terms.

sources.current_anchor: A workflow execution is one full workflow run regardless of step count; AI Assistant credits are a separate monthly allowance on relevant Cloud plans.
Starter currently lists 2,500 executions and 2,300 AI credits/month; Pro tiers list 10k/50k executions and 5,700/13,700 AI credits; annual billing affects price, not allowances.
Credit unit prices/allowances may change; included/top-up credit treatment and expiration/refund constraints are material.
30% on n8n Cloud referrals for 12 months; application/approval; monthly PayPal payouts at EUR100+ balance.
